dedupe_keys.name: nerc ceh robin pipeline robin hydrometric data processing v1 0

description: The UK Centre for Ecology and Hydrology publishes the ROBIN hydrometric processing pipeline, archived as version 1.0 in August 2025. The Zenodo release states CC BY 4.0 and free access; the linked GitHub metadata does not separately identify a licence. Its R Markdown example processes a single gauging station from agency, station, date, flow and quality-flag fields. Outputs include high- and low-flow statistics, seasonal quantiles, drought events and trend or breakpoint tests. These products can prepare calibration and stress-test inputs for water-supply and flood-management simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this processing tool. The associated ROBIN data span 1863–2022, but the software itself accepts user-supplied station periods. The example uses calendar quarters and a January–December hydrological year for consistency, which may not match local hydrology. Completeness thresholds are configurable and partly described as provisional. Package compatibility, statistical correctness and workflow execution were not tested.
